name: PureLink VCX2 RX — silk print replica

cutouts: Fusion cut-out SVG: Cut-outs trace each connector’s visible outline, not the manufacturer’s recommended panel cut-out with clearance and tolerance.

Rear panel: supplier drawing V1.1 draws the ports view rotated 180° (upside-down) relative to how the panel actually mounts; all rear-panel positions below were corrected by mirroring both axes (real_x = 160 − raw_x, real_y = 30 − raw_y), not signed off against the physical part.
HDMI (OUTPUT): estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1 (HDPRX-EUB40D-DE0012), not signed off.
RJ45, ETHERNET: estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
RJ45/Amphenol, VCX input (front panel): estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
USB-A, DEVICE 1/2: estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
USB-C, DEVICE 3 / SERVICE / PD: estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
Phoenix 5-pin, AUDIO (OUTPUT): estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.

Ground screw (M4): three positions (near PD, near DEVICE 3, inside OUTPUT) estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1; the drawing's own icon reads smaller than this tool's fixed M4 ground-screw art, so positions were nudged apart from their neighbouring port to avoid a false overlap — not signed off.
LED (power, LINK): positions estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
silkscreen: Silkscreen SVG: Silk artwork replicated from the supplier's own silkprint drawing V1.1 (2026-10-20, HDCVT / Shenzhen Wanshi Technology); dimensions on that drawing are guides only and were not treated as exact. Not compared against production silk files.

The drawing's top (lid) view, left/right side views, and the separate bottom-face legend rectangle (Rating Label / MAC address / NOTES) were used only as context — not reproduced as additional panels.

Rear panel: corrected from the drawing's 180°-rotated ports view (see cutouts note); frame titlePos chosen so that, after correction, each frame's own title sits at the top and each member's function label breaks the frame's bottom border, matching the as-drawn relationship once both axes are flipped.
HDMI: estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
RJ45 (ETHERNET, VCX): estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
USB-A (DEVICE 1/2): estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
USB-C (DEVICE 3, SERVICE, PD): estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
Phoenix 5-pin (AUDIO): pin order read off the rotated drawing and corrected (reversed) to "+, −, [gnd], +, −" with L on pins 1-2 and R on pins 4-5; estimated, not signed off.
Ground screw (M4) x3: estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
LED (power, LINK): colours assumed red/green by PureLink convention (drawing is monochrome line art); not signed off.
